# Casa Siesta

> Three family-run holiday apartments (Mar, Brisa and Sol) in Neviđane on Pašman island, Croatia, about 200 m from the village beach. Booked directly with the owners by WhatsApp, phone or email. Open June to September.

Address: Put Tratice 6, 23264 Neviđane, Pašman, Croatia
WhatsApp and phone: +385 98 830 940
Email: info@casa-siesta.org
Website languages: English, Croatian, Slovenian, German, Czech, Italian, Polish. The hosts speak Croatian and English.

## Apartments

- Mar: whole upper floor, about 51 m², two bedrooms (double bed; two single beds) plus a sofa bed, sleeps up to 5, roof terrace with pergola and sea view, balcony. €100 a night; €120 from 15 July to 15 August.
- Sol: ground floor, about 51 m², two bedrooms (queen-size bed; bunk bed and single bed), living room with kitchen and dining area, bathroom, covered terrace under a vine, sleeps up to 5. €100 a night; €120 from 15 July to 15 August.
- Brisa: smaller ground-floor apartment, about 30 m², one bedroom with a bunk bed, living room with a new kitchen and a sofa bed that opens into a double, bathroom, uses the garden, sleeps up to 4. €80 a night; €100 from 15 July to 15 August.

Prices are per night for the whole apartment and include bed linen, towels, tourist tax and final cleaning. All three apartments are officially rated three stars.

## Stay details

- Minimum stay 7 nights; arrival on any day. Check-in from 14:00, check-out by 10:00.
- Air conditioning, Wi-Fi, kitchen with dishwasher, washing machine in every apartment.
- Free parking for 5–6 cars. Garden with barbecue. Pets welcome at no extra charge. Baby cot and high chair available. Non-smoking.
- Guests can borrow a paddleboard, kayaks and bikes.

## Getting there

- From Zadar: car ferry from Gaženica port to Preko on Ugljan (25 min), then about 30 min by car via the bridge to Pašman.
- From Biograd na Moru: ferry to Tkon (20 min), then about 15 min by car.
- Zadar airport is about 1.5 hours away including the ferry; Split airport about 2.5 hours.
